title: Fabrication and in vitro cytocompatibility evaluation of porous bone scaffold based on cuttlefish bone-derived nano-carbonated hydroxyapatite reinforced with polyethylene oxide/chitosan fibrous structure
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5135-5150
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08457H, Paper
Open Access

Musyafa Riziq Habiburrohman, Muhammad Amir Jamilludin, Nilam Cahyati, Nendar Herdianto, Yusril Yusuf
In this work, we developed a novel porous bone scaffold based on cuttlefish bone-derived nano-carbonated hydroxyapatite reinforced with polyethylene oxide/chitosan fibrous network (nCHA/PEO/CS), which demonstrated enhanced cytocompatibility.
